note: Served at https://alphaintellabs.com/promptcad/models.json and shipped inside PromptCAD. Sizes and filenames were read off the Hugging Face repositories, not guessed - the Nemotron file is 'Nemotron3' with no hyphen even though its repo is 'Nemotron-3'.

local.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 4B
local.summary: The default. Small enough to run on a laptop CPU, trained for reasoning and agentic use, and the one PromptCAD tunes its prompts against.

local.name: Google Gemma 4 12B
local.summary: Noticeably stronger on multi-step geometry, at roughly three times the download and a real GPU or 16 GB of RAM to be pleasant.

cloud.name: GLM-5.2
cloud.summary: Open weights under MIT, but Z.ai puts the floor at eight H100s. Reach it through an API provider rather than downloading 744B parameters.

cloud.name: Inkling
cloud.summary: Open weights, multimodal, and far past what a workstation will hold. API only in practice.

cloud.name: Inkling-Small
cloud.summary: The efficient Inkling variant. Still around 140 GB quantized, so it is a server model, not a desktop one.
